content.short: Venus Protocol is a top 5 multichain lending and borrowing protocol.
content.description: Venus Protocol enables decentralized crypto borrowing and lending across multiple blockchains. With Venus Prime, users can earn higher yields by staking $XVS, its native governance token. The protocol supports Ethereum, BNB Chain, opBNB, Arbitrum, ZKSync and Optimism, unlocking cross-chain access to flexible lending and borrowing, liquidity provisioning, and governance participation for developers and users alike. This architecture promotes diversified liquidity, transparent governance, and cross-chain opportunities for lenders, borrowers, and builders.
